name: growth_roster
prompt:
Create ONE finished portrait mobile game UI concept, approximately 1024x2208 and the same tall phone aspect ratio as the references. Traditional Chinese, readable hierarchy. Original game 全員推王. This is a substantive information-architecture redesign informed by commercial RPG roster and hero-detail patterns, not another decorative reskin of the old dense screen. Build original components, no copied game logos, characters or branded UI. Unified style: the stepped crisp pixel borders of reference D, matte charcoal background, restrained slate-grey panels, warm ivory text, amber selection and primary actions, small cyan secondary accents. Flat pixel shading, modest 2-pixel stepped corners, compact original pixel icons, no filigree, excessive gold, bloom, smooth glass, leather, cloth UI or nested decorative cards. Only a few purposeful containers. Keep the pixel-art hero identities and natural equipment colours from the supplied game assets. No phone hardware, no outer presentation, no side-by-side multi-screen image.
Reference 1 supplies pixel UI LANGUAGE ONLY, not a layout. Reference 2 gives six actual class sprite identities. Reference 3 is the selected sword hero 蘿德. NEW SCREEN: HERO ROSTER AND CLASS GROWTH OVERVIEW. Do not put a pinned detailed hero panel at the bottom. Do not use tall full-body character cards. Make the navigation and roster feel like a polished, real shipping mobile RPG with many collectible heroes. Layout: top compact header 養成 with 金幣 1,280 and 突破素材 3. Below it a very compact 行軍小隊 strip: five SMALL SQUARE head-and-shoulder pixel portrait slots, tiny names, levels and a green 行軍 marker, not five tall full-body cards. Next six compact class tabs 盾 劍 槍 弓 法 補 with 劍 selected. A single clear horizontal CLASS UPGRADE module: sword icon, 職業等級 14, 全職業英雄 ×2.72; one amber button 升級（272 金）. This is the upgrade focus of the overview. Then a roster heading 劍職英雄, small 稀有度 sorting control, and a spacious vertically scrolling FOUR-COLUMN grid of TWELVE SMALL SQUARE FACE PORTRAIT tiles in three rows. The portraits fill most of each tile, with slim rarity corner labels SSR gold, SR purple, R blue, N grey, compact level badges, small breakthrough stars, name below the face. Names include 蘿德、伊妮、蒂斯、佩文. Selected 蘿德 is a single amber outline, not a huge glowing ornate card. Faces are pixel head crops of the supplied sword class, with subtle tint variation; never paste twelve tiny full-body swordsmen. Clearly show a slim scroll indicator. Keep the area below the grid calm: a small helper line 點選英雄查看詳情 is enough, no hero stats or duplicate upgrade card. Footer has two modest utility buttons 行軍 1 小時 and 一鍵養成, followed by ONE wide primary 開始推王 button. The roster should occupy the majority of usable space; footer stays compact and thumb-friendly. This must look visibly reorganized compared with the rejected UI, not the same stack with a new border.

name: growth_detail

This is a substantive information-architecture redesign informed by commercial RPG roster and hero-detail patterns, not another decorative reskin of the old dense screen. Reference 1 supplies the shared pixel UI material system only. Reference 2 is the EXACT sword hero 蘿德; retain his face, hairstyle, pale cape, gambeson, longsword and silhouette. NEW SCREEN: DEDICATED HERO DETAIL, visually complementary to a compact roster screen. This is not another roster mockup. Use a commercial mobile-RPG character-detail hierarchy: back navigation, strong hero identity and large character display, concise progression information, one main growth action and one squad action. Top back arrow and 英雄詳情, with small 金幣 1,280 and 突破素材 3 indicators. Upper half: name 蘿德 in large readable type, SSR badge and 劍 badge, followed by a beautifully presented LARGE full-body pixel sprite of the supplied hero on a very subdued ruined-stone camp niche; keep the hero dominant and readable, no anime illustration or unrelated character. Use empty space around the hero rather than panels filling every corner. Put Lv 4／10 and 突破 ★0 close to the name, a small calm EXP bar below the hero display. Lower half: two clearly separated slim sections instead of a wall of stats: 招牌技「斷鋼斬」 with a small original pixel sword icon and 強化 +0%; then 職業加成 with 職業等級 14 and 全職業英雄 ×2.72 as quiet context. A focused breakthrough area states 突破提升等級上限 and shows required material 1／持有 3, without inventing numerical next-level bonuses or equipment slots. Bottom primary button 突破（1 素材）, secondary outlined button 派去行軍. A quiet bottom link 返回英雄名冊. Do not add summon, shop, equipment, quests, currencies or skill trees. No 12-card roster on this detail screen and no repeated full-width battle CTA. The character and two useful actions should be immediately understood, with generous breathing room and the same restrained grey pixel chrome as the roster.

This screen is a restrained refinement of D, not a change to the approved battlefield direction. Reference 1 is the actual battle screenshot and locks the entire underlying stage, camera, three army crowds on the LEFT, troll on the RIGHT, red ground danger circles, ruined fortress, pixel sprites and warm dusk/cool shadow lighting. Preserve those assets and the overall composition closely, redesign UI overlay only. Reference 2 is D: borrow its crisp pixel interface vocabulary but simplify it, remove gratuitous gold corners and reduce oversized alert/skill panels. Reference 3 locks the exact red sword-shield, blue bow-staff and yellow sun-ring flags; do not swap their emblems. Header is compact, top roughly 12 percent: 關卡王・棍棒巨魔, 第一階段, large readable 118, thin boss HP bar 72%, and smaller 存活 94／100　總輸出 351／秒. A restrained horizontal temporary danger notification just beneath the HUD: small pixel warning icon and 落石！把旗子拖出紅圈！, high contrast coral/ivory, not a giant explosive banner. Small boss part target chips 角、持棍手臂、腿 each with a tiny HP bar; 角 shows a discrete ◎ target reticle. Keep labels narrow and away from army silhouettes. The signature skill notification is a SMALL left-side panel above the crowds, approximately 40 percent width and 9 percent height: pixel mage avatar, 「隕石術」, SSR 法・菲嘉特, short second line 隕石砸向瞄準的部位. Do not let the skill card become the screen's largest UI element. Keep the central battlefield open with no painted replacement characters or new scene architecture. Bottom compact tactical controls: small red/blue/gold group selector badges 近戰 遠程 輔助, selected 近戰團 52 人 and a quiet instruction 拖旗子，或點地面移動; 士氣 bar; two decisive pixel buttons 全員歸位 and 大招. Thin stepped grey frames, amber special button and ivory text, no metallic floral borders, no fake depth shadows, no UI glass. Spend most screen area on the action and preserve the source battlefield's human-scale army/boss relationship.
